nodes.title: Edit instruction - image 1 is main; enabled extras are references
widgets_values: Use image 1 as the main scene and composition. Apply the requested edit while preserving the same primary person's recognizable identity, facial structure, age, and natural proportions. Use only enabled additional images as visual references for clothing, pose, environment, style, or props.
